summary.result: The results show that the GHG emission of railway transportation sector decreased during these 6 years.
summary.background: In this paper, I analyze the GHG (greenhouse gas) emission factor of the domestic railway transportation sector using the LMDI (Log Mean Divisia Index) methodology.
summary.method: The analysis period was from 2011 to 2016, and the analysis objects were an intercity railway, wide area railway, and urban railway.
